name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.

contributions.label: Kafka cluster
contributions.description: Apache Kafka connection over PLAINTEXT, TLS and SASL (PLAIN/SCRAM), with host-managed secrets and read-only policy.

fields.label: Connection name
fields.description: Name shown in the connection list.

fields.label: Connection source
fields.description: Where broker endpoints come from: direct bootstrap list, or discovered from ZooKeeper (zk_servers).

fields.label: Bootstrap servers
fields.description: Comma- or newline-separated broker list (host:port).

fields.label: ZooKeeper servers
fields.description: Comma-separated ZooKeeper ensemble (host:port[/chroot]) used to discover brokers when the connection source is zookeeper.

fields.label: Security protocol
fields.description: Protocol used to connect to the brokers.

fields.label: SASL mechanism
fields.description: SASL mechanism used for SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL.

fields.label: SASL username
fields.description: Username for the SASL mechanism; required for PLAIN and SCRAM mechanisms (not needed for GSSAPI).

fields.label: SASL password
fields.description: Password for the SASL mechanism; required for PLAIN and SCRAM mechanisms (not needed for GSSAPI); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

fields.label: Kerberos principal
fields.description: Client principal in user@REALM form used with the keytab; required when the SASL mechanism is GSSAPI.

fields.label: Kerberos keytab path
fields.description: Path to the keytab file on this machine (file path only, never the content); required when the SASL mechanism is GSSAPI.

fields.label: Kerberos realm
fields.description: Kerberos realm; empty derives the realm from kerberos_principal (user@REALM) or krb5.conf.

fields.label: Kerberos service name
fields.description: Kafka service name used for the GSSAPI ticket (the first part of broker principal kafka/BROKER@REALM).

fields.label: krb5.conf path
fields.description: Path to krb5.conf; empty falls back to $KRB5_CONFIG, then /etc/krb5.conf.

fields.label: OAuth token source
fields.description: Choose AWS MSK IAM or a static token. OAUTHBEARER requires SASL over TLS (SASL_SSL).

fields.label: MSK AWS region
fields.description: AWS region of the MSK cluster used to sign the IAM token (for example us-east-1); required when the OAuth token source is MSK IAM.

fields.label: AWS access key ID
fields.description: Access key ID used to sign the MSK IAM token; leave empty to use the default AWS credential chain.

fields.label: AWS secret access key
fields.description: Secret access key used to sign the MSK IAM token (provided together with the access key ID); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

fields.label: AWS session token
fields.description: Optional temporary session token (STS) for the MSK IAM credentials; leave empty for long-lived keys.

fields.label: OAuth static token
fields.description: Static OAUTHBEARER bearer token sent as-is during SASL authentication; required when the OAuth token source is static token; stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

fields.label: CA certificate (PEM)
fields.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify broker certificates; empty uses the system roots.

fields.label: Client certificate (PEM)
fields.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS).

fields.label: Client private key (PEM)
fields.description: Paste the complete PEM key including BEGIN/END lines, together with the client certificate for mutual TLS. Leave both empty for server-only TLS.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Accept broker certificates without verification (development only).

fields.label: Schema Registry
fields.description: Which schema registry backend to use: none (schema features off), Confluent-compatible REST, or AWS Glue Schema Registry.

fields.label: Schema Registry URL
fields.description: Confluent-compatible Schema Registry base URL (including Redpanda built-in registry); required when schema registry is Confluent-compatible.

fields.label: Schema Registry username
fields.description: Username for Schema Registry basic auth; leave empty when the registry is unauthenticated.

fields.label: Schema Registry password
fields.description: Password for Schema Registry basic auth; stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

fields.label: AWS Glue region
fields.description: AWS region of the Glue Schema Registry (for example us-east-1); required when schema registry is AWS Glue.

fields.label: AWS Glue registry name
fields.description: Name of the AWS Glue schema registry used as the subject namespace for Glue schema management; required when schema registry is AWS Glue.

fields.label: AWS Glue auth mode
fields.description: AWS credential source for Glue: default chain (environment/shared config) or static access key.

fields.label: AWS access key ID
fields.description: Access key ID used when glue auth mode is static (required in that case); leave empty for the default credential chain.

fields.label: AWS secret access key
fields.description: Secret access key for the static AWS credentials (required when glue auth mode is static); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

fields.label: AWS session token
fields.description: Optional temporary session token for the static AWS credentials (STS); leave empty for long-lived keys.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Optional client.id reported to brokers; defaults to dbx-plugin-kafka.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.description: Reject all write operations (produce, topic create/alter/delete, group delete and offset reset, ACL writes).

fields.label: Allow delete operations
fields.description: Allow delete-class operations (topics/delete, groups/delete, acls/delete); has no effect while read-only is on.

fields.label: Import: paste client properties
fields.description: Optional: paste a Kafka client properties snippet (bootstrap.servers, security.protocol, sasl.*, ssl.*, schema.registry.url, basic.auth.*). Recognized keys are merged into the fields above when the connection is saved or tested (pasted values win); Java keystore path keys (ssl.truststore.location and similar) are unsupported and reported as ignored. The pasted text is stored via host secret binding, never in plain text.

contributions.label: Kafka Workbench
contributions.description: Browse topics, consume and produce messages, and manage consumer groups and ACLs.

zh-CN.name: Kafka Studio
zh-CN.description: 在一个工作台中管理 Apache Kafka：查看 topic 与分区、生产和消费消息、过滤与解码 payload、监控消费组 lag、管理 offset 和 ACL、流式消费并导出结果。

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Kafka 集群
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: 通过 PLAINTEXT、TLS 与 SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）连接 Apache Kafka；凭据由宿主 secret binding 管理，插件不持久化。

display_name.label: 连接名称
display_name.description: 连接列表中显示的名称。

bootstrap_servers.label: Bootstrap servers
bootstrap_servers.description: 以逗号或换行分隔的 broker 列表（host:port）。

security_protocol.label: 安全协议
security_protocol.description: 与 broker 建立连接所用的协议。

sasl_mechanism.label: SASL 机制
sasl_mechanism.description: SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL 使用的 SASL 机制。

sasl_username.label: SASL 用户名
sasl_username.description: SASL 认证使用的用户名；PLAIN/SCRAM 机制必填（GSSAPI 不需要）。

sasl_password.label: SASL 密码
sasl_password.description: SASL 认证使用的密码；PLAIN/SCRAM 机制必填（GSSAPI 不需要）；经宿主 secret binding 存储，插件不持久化。

oauth_token_source.label: OAuth token 来源
oauth_token_source.description: 请选择 AWS MSK IAM 或静态令牌。OAUTHBEARER 必须使用 SASL over TLS（SASL_SSL）。

msk_region.label: MSK AWS 区域
msk_region.description: MSK 集群所在的 AWS 区域（如 us-east-1），用于签名 IAM token；OAuth token 来源选 MSK IAM 时必填。

msk_access_key_id.label: AWS Access Key ID
msk_access_key_id.description: 签名 MSK IAM token 使用的 Access Key ID；留空使用 AWS 默认凭据链。

msk_secret_access_key.label: AWS Secret Access Key
msk_secret_access_key.description: 签名 MSK IAM token 使用的 Secret Access Key（与 Access Key ID 成对填写）；经宿主 secret binding 存储，插件不持久化。

msk_session_token.label: AWS Session Token
msk_session_token.description: MSK IAM 凭据的可选临时会话令牌（STS）；长期密钥请留空。

oauth_static_token.label: OAuth 静态 token
oauth_static_token.description: SASL 认证原样携带的 OAUTHBEARER 静态 token；OAuth token 来源选静态 token 时必填；经宿主 secret binding 存储，插件不持久化。

tls_ca_cert.label: CA 证书（PEM）
tls_ca_cert.description: 用于校验 broker 证书的 PEM 编码 CA 证书；留空使用系统根证书。

tls_client_cert.label: 客户端证书（PEM）
tls_client_cert.description: 双向 TLS（mTLS）使用的 PEM 编码客户端证书。

tls_client_key.label: 客户端私钥（PEM）
tls_client_key.description: 粘贴完整 PEM 私钥（含 BEGIN/END 行），并配套填写客户端证书以使用双向 TLS；仅验证服务器时两项均留空。

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: 跳过 TLS 校验
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: 不校验 broker 证书（仅建议开发环境使用）。

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: 上报给 broker 的可选 client.id；缺省为 dbx-plugin-kafka。

read_only.label: 只读模式
read_only.description: 拒绝一切写操作（生产消息、创建/变更/删除 topic、消费组删除与 offset 重置、ACL 写入）。

allow_delete.label: 允许删除类操作
allow_delete.description: 允许删除类操作（topics/delete、groups/delete、acls/delete）；只读模式下本项无效。

connection_source.label: 连接来源
connection_source.description: broker 地址来源：直连 bootstrap 列表，或经 ZooKeeper（zk_servers）发现。

zk_servers.label: ZooKeeper 服务器
zk_servers.description: ZooKeeper 集群地址（host:port[/chroot]，逗号分隔）；连接来源为 zookeeper 时用于发现 broker。

kerberos_service_name.label: Kerberos 服务名
kerberos_service_name.description: GSSAPI 票据使用的 Kafka 服务名（broker principal kafka/BROKER@REALM 的第一段）。

kerberos_realm.label: Kerberos realm
kerberos_realm.description: Kerberos realm；留空时从 kerberos_principal（user@REALM）或 krb5.conf 推导。

kerberos_principal.label: Kerberos principal
kerberos_principal.description: 配合 keytab 使用的客户端 principal（user@REALM 形式）；GSSAPI 必填。

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Kerberos keytab 路径
kerberos_keytab_path.description: 本机 keytab 文件路径（仅路径，不收文件内容）；GSSAPI 必填。

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: krb5.conf 路径
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: krb5.conf 路径；留空依次回落 $KRB5_CONFIG、/etc/krb5.conf。

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Schema Registry 后端选择：none（禁用 schema 能力）、Confluent 兼容 REST 或 AWS Glue Schema Registry。

sr_url.label: Schema Registry URL
sr_url.description: Confluent 兼容 Schema Registry 基础 URL（含 Redpanda 内置 Registry）；schema registry 选 Confluent 兼容时必填。

sr_username.label: Schema Registry 用户名
sr_username.description: Schema Registry basic auth 用户名；Registry 未开启认证时留空。

sr_password.label: Schema Registry 密码
sr_password.description: Schema Registry basic auth 密码；经宿主 secret binding 存储，插件不持久化。

glue_region.label: AWS Glue 区域
glue_region.description: Glue Schema Registry 所在的 AWS 区域（如 us-east-1）；schema registry 选 AWS Glue 时必填。

glue_registry_name.label: AWS Glue registry 名称
glue_registry_name.description: AWS Glue schema registry 的名称，作为 Glue schema 管理的 subject 命名空间；schema registry 选 AWS Glue 时必填。

glue_auth_mode.label: AWS Glue 认证模式
glue_auth_mode.description: Glue 使用的 AWS 凭据来源：默认凭据链（环境变量/共享配置）或静态访问密钥。

glue_access_key_id.label: AWS Access Key ID
glue_access_key_id.description: glue 认证模式为静态访问密钥时使用的 Access Key ID；静态访问密钥模式必填，默认凭据链留空。

glue_secret_access_key.label: AWS Secret Access Key
glue_secret_access_key.description: 静态 AWS 凭据的 Secret Access Key；静态访问密钥模式必填；由宿主 secret binding 保存，插件不持久化。

glue_session_token.label: AWS Session Token
glue_session_token.description: 静态 AWS 凭据的可选临时会话令牌（STS）；长期密钥请留空。

properties_import.label: 导入：粘贴客户端 properties
properties_import.description: 可选：粘贴 Kafka 客户端 properties 片段（bootstrap.servers、security.protocol、sasl.*、ssl.*、schema.registry.url、basic.auth.*）。保存或测试连接时可识别键合并进上方结构化字段（粘贴值优先）；Java keystore 路径类键（ssl.truststore.location 等）不支持，会列入忽略清单。粘贴文本经宿主 secret binding 加密存储，绝不明文落盘。

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Kafka 工作台
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: 浏览 topic、消费与生产消息、管理消费组与 ACL。

zh-TW.name: Kafka Studio
zh-TW.description: DBX 的 Kafka 主控台外掛：topic 與分割區、訊息生產與消費（過濾/解碼）、消費組（lag 與 offset 重置）、ACL、串流消費與匯出。

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Kafka 叢集
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: 透過 PLAINTEXT、TLS 與 SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）連線 Apache Kafka；憑證由宿主 secret binding 管理，外掛不持久化。

display_name.label: 連線名稱
display_name.description: 連線清單中顯示的名稱。

bootstrap_servers.label: Bootstrap 伺服器
bootstrap_servers.description: 以逗號或換行分隔的 broker 清單（host:port）。

security_protocol.label: 安全協定
security_protocol.description: 與 broker 建立連線所用的協定。

sasl_mechanism.label: SASL 機制
sasl_mechanism.description: SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL 使用的 SASL 機制。

sasl_username.label: SASL 使用者名稱
sasl_username.description: SASL 認證使用的使用者名稱；PLAIN/SCRAM 機制必填（GSSAPI 不需要）。

sasl_password.label: SASL 密碼
sasl_password.description: SASL 認證使用的密碼；PLAIN/SCRAM 機制必填（GSSAPI 不需要）；經宿主 secret binding 儲存，外掛不持久化。

oauth_token_source.label: OAuth token 來源
oauth_token_source.description: 請選擇 AWS MSK IAM 或靜態權杖。OAUTHBEARER 必須使用 SASL over TLS（SASL_SSL）。

msk_region.label: MSK AWS 區域
msk_region.description: MSK 叢集所在的 AWS 區域（如 us-east-1），用於簽署 IAM token；OAuth token 來源選 MSK IAM 時必填。

msk_access_key_id.label: AWS Access Key ID
msk_access_key_id.description: 簽署 MSK IAM token 使用的 Access Key ID；留空使用 AWS 預設憑證鏈。

msk_secret_access_key.label: AWS Secret Access Key
msk_secret_access_key.description: 簽署 MSK IAM token 使用的 Secret Access Key（與 Access Key ID 成對填寫）；經宿主 secret binding 儲存，外掛不持久化。

msk_session_token.label: AWS Session Token
msk_session_token.description: MSK IAM 憑證的選用臨時工作階段權杖（STS）；長期金鑰請留空。

oauth_static_token.label: OAuth 靜態 token
oauth_static_token.description: SASL 認證原樣攜帶的 OAUTHBEARER 靜態 token；OAuth token 來源選靜態 token 時必填；經宿主 secret binding 儲存，外掛不持久化。

tls_ca_cert.label: CA 憑證（PEM）
tls_ca_cert.description: 用於驗證 broker 憑證的 PEM 編碼 CA 憑證；留空使用系統根憑證。

tls_client_cert.label: 用戶端憑證（PEM）
tls_client_cert.description: 雙向 TLS（mTLS）使用的 PEM 編碼用戶端憑證。

tls_client_key.label: 用戶端私鑰（PEM）
tls_client_key.description: 貼上完整 PEM 私鑰（含 BEGIN/END 行），並搭配客戶端憑證以使用雙向 TLS；僅驗證伺服器時兩項皆留空。

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: 略過 TLS 驗證
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: 不驗證 broker 憑證（僅建議開發環境使用）。

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: 回報給 broker 的選擇性 client.id；預設為 dbx-plugin-kafka。

read_only.label: 唯讀模式
read_only.description: 拒絕一切寫入操作（生產訊息、建立/變更/刪除 topic、消費組刪除與 offset 重置、ACL 寫入）。

allow_delete.label: 允許刪除類操作
allow_delete.description: 允許刪除類操作（topics/delete、groups/delete、acls/delete）；唯讀模式下本項無效。

connection_source.label: 連線來源
connection_source.description: broker 位址來源：直連 bootstrap 清單，或經 ZooKeeper（zk_servers）探索。

zk_servers.label: ZooKeeper 伺服器
zk_servers.description: ZooKeeper 叢集位址（host:port[/chroot]，逗號分隔）；連線來源為 zookeeper 時用於探索 broker。

kerberos_service_name.label: Kerberos 服務名
kerberos_service_name.description: GSSAPI 票據使用的 Kafka 服務名（broker principal kafka/BROKER@REALM 的第一段）。

kerberos_realm.label: Kerberos realm
kerberos_realm.description: Kerberos realm；留空時從 kerberos_principal（user@REALM）或 krb5.conf 推導。

kerberos_principal.label: Kerberos principal
kerberos_principal.description: 配合 keytab 使用的用戶端 principal（user@REALM 形式）；GSSAPI 必填。

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Kerberos keytab 路徑
kerberos_keytab_path.description: 本機 keytab 檔案路徑（僅路徑，不收檔案內容）；GSSAPI 必填。

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: krb5.conf 路徑
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: krb5.conf 路徑；留空依次回落 $KRB5_CONFIG、/etc/krb5.conf。

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Schema Registry 後端選擇：none（停用 schema 能力）、Confluent 相容 REST 或 AWS Glue Schema Registry。

sr_url.label: Schema Registry URL
sr_url.description: Confluent 相容 Schema Registry 基礎 URL（含 Redpanda 內建 Registry）；schema registry 選 Confluent 相容時必填。

sr_username.label: Schema Registry 使用者名稱
sr_username.description: Schema Registry basic auth 使用者名稱；Registry 未開啟認證時留空。

sr_password.label: Schema Registry 密碼
sr_password.description: Schema Registry basic auth 密碼；經宿主 secret binding 儲存，外掛不持久化。

glue_region.label: AWS Glue 區域
glue_region.description: Glue Schema Registry 所在的 AWS 區域（如 us-east-1）；schema registry 選 AWS Glue 時必填。

glue_registry_name.label: AWS Glue registry 名稱
glue_registry_name.description: AWS Glue schema registry 的名稱，作為 Glue schema 管理的 subject 命名空間；schema registry 選 AWS Glue 時必填。

glue_auth_mode.label: AWS Glue 驗證模式
glue_auth_mode.description: Glue 使用的 AWS 憑證來源：預設憑證鏈（環境變數/共用設定）或靜態存取金鑰。

glue_access_key_id.label: AWS Access Key ID
glue_access_key_id.description: glue 驗證模式為靜態存取金鑰時使用的 Access Key ID；靜態存取金鑰模式必填，預設憑證鏈留空。

glue_secret_access_key.label: AWS Secret Access Key
glue_secret_access_key.description: 靜態 AWS 憑證的 Secret Access Key；靜態存取金鑰模式必填；由宿主 secret binding 保存，外掛不持久化。

glue_session_token.label: AWS Session Token
glue_session_token.description: 靜態 AWS 憑證的選用臨時工作階段權杖（STS）；長期金鑰請留空。

properties_import.label: 匯入：貼上用戶端 properties
properties_import.description: 可選：貼上 Kafka 用戶端 properties 片段（bootstrap.servers、security.protocol、sasl.*、ssl.*、schema.registry.url、basic.auth.*）。儲存或測試連線時可識別鍵合併進上方結構化欄位（貼上值優先）；Java keystore 路徑類鍵（ssl.truststore.location 等）不支援，會列入忽略清單。貼上文字經宿主 secret binding 加密儲存，絕不明文落盤。

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Kafka 工作台
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: 瀏覽 topic、消費與生產訊息、管理消費組與 ACL。

en.name: Kafka Studio
en.description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Kafka cluster
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: Apache Kafka connection over PLAINTEXT, TLS and SASL (PLAIN/SCRAM), with host-managed secrets and read-only policy.

display_name.label: Connection name
display_name.description: Name shown in the connection list.

security_protocol.label: Security protocol
security_protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the brokers.

sasl_mechanism.label: SASL mechanism
sasl_mechanism.description: SASL mechanism used for SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL.

sasl_username.label: SASL username
sasl_username.description: Username for the SASL mechanism; required for PLAIN and SCRAM mechanisms (not needed for GSSAPI).

sasl_password.label: SASL password
sasl_password.description: Password for the SASL mechanism; required for PLAIN and SCRAM mechanisms (not needed for GSSAPI); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

oauth_token_source.label: OAuth token source
oauth_token_source.description: Choose AWS MSK IAM or a static token. OAUTHBEARER requires SASL over TLS (SASL_SSL).

msk_region.label: MSK AWS region
msk_region.description: AWS region of the MSK cluster used to sign the IAM token (for example us-east-1); required when the OAuth token source is MSK IAM.

msk_access_key_id.label: AWS access key ID
msk_access_key_id.description: Access key ID used to sign the MSK IAM token; leave empty to use the default AWS credential chain.

msk_secret_access_key.label: AWS secret access key
msk_secret_access_key.description: Secret access key used to sign the MSK IAM token (provided together with the access key ID); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

msk_session_token.label: AWS session token
msk_session_token.description: Optional temporary session token (STS) for the MSK IAM credentials; leave empty for long-lived keys.

oauth_static_token.label: OAuth static token
oauth_static_token.description: Static OAUTHBEARER bearer token sent as-is during SASL authentication; required when the OAuth token source is static token; stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

tls_ca_cert.label: CA certificate (PEM)
tls_ca_cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify broker certificates; empty uses the system roots.

tls_client_cert.label: Client certificate (PEM)
tls_client_cert.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS).

tls_client_key.label: Client private key (PEM)
tls_client_key.description: Paste the complete PEM key including BEGIN/END lines, together with the client certificate for mutual TLS. Leave both empty for server-only TLS.

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: Skip TLS verification
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: Accept broker certificates without verification (development only).

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: Optional client.id reported to brokers; defaults to dbx-plugin-kafka.

read_only.label: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Reject all write operations (produce, topic create/alter/delete, group delete and offset reset, ACL writes).

allow_delete.label: Allow delete operations
allow_delete.description: Allow delete-class operations (topics/delete, groups/delete, acls/delete); has no effect while read-only is on.

connection_source.label: Connection source
connection_source.description: Where broker endpoints come from: direct bootstrap list, or discovered from ZooKeeper (zk_servers).

zk_servers.label: ZooKeeper servers
zk_servers.description: Comma-separated ZooKeeper ensemble (host:port[/chroot]) used to discover brokers when the connection source is zookeeper.

kerberos_service_name.label: Kerberos service name
kerberos_service_name.description: Kafka service name used for the GSSAPI ticket (the first part of broker principal kafka/BROKER@REALM).

kerberos_realm.label: Kerberos realm
kerberos_realm.description: Kerberos realm; empty derives the realm from kerberos_principal (user@REALM) or krb5.conf.

kerberos_principal.label: Kerberos principal
kerberos_principal.description: Client principal in user@REALM form used with the keytab; required when the SASL mechanism is GSSAPI.

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Kerberos keytab path
kerberos_keytab_path.description: Path to the keytab file on this machine (file path only, never the content); required when the SASL mechanism is GSSAPI.

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: krb5.conf path
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: Path to krb5.conf; empty falls back to $KRB5_CONFIG, then /etc/krb5.conf.

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Which schema registry backend to use: none (schema features off), Confluent-compatible REST, or AWS Glue Schema Registry.

sr_url.label: Schema Registry URL
sr_url.description: Confluent-compatible Schema Registry base URL (including Redpanda built-in registry); required when schema registry is Confluent-compatible.

sr_username.label: Schema Registry username
sr_username.description: Username for Schema Registry basic auth; leave empty when the registry is unauthenticated.

sr_password.label: Schema Registry password
sr_password.description: Password for Schema Registry basic auth; stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

glue_region.label: AWS Glue region
glue_region.description: AWS region of the Glue Schema Registry (for example us-east-1); required when schema registry is AWS Glue.

glue_registry_name.label: AWS Glue registry name
glue_registry_name.description: Name of the AWS Glue schema registry used as the subject namespace for Glue schema management; required when schema registry is AWS Glue.

glue_auth_mode.label: AWS Glue auth mode
glue_auth_mode.description: AWS credential source for Glue: default chain (environment/shared config) or static access key.

glue_access_key_id.label: AWS access key ID
glue_access_key_id.description: Access key ID used when glue auth mode is static (required in that case); leave empty for the default credential chain.

glue_secret_access_key.label: AWS secret access key
glue_secret_access_key.description: Secret access key for the static AWS credentials (required when glue auth mode is static); stored via host secret binding, never persisted by the plugin.

glue_session_token.label: AWS session token
glue_session_token.description: Optional temporary session token for the static AWS credentials (STS); leave empty for long-lived keys.

properties_import.label: Import: paste client properties
properties_import.description: Optional: paste a Kafka client properties snippet (bootstrap.servers, security.protocol, sasl.*, ssl.*, schema.registry.url, basic.auth.*). Recognized keys are merged into the fields above when the connection is saved or tested (pasted values win); Java keystore path keys (ssl.truststore.location and similar) are unsupported and reported as ignored. The pasted text is stored via host secret binding, never in plain text.

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Kafka Workbench
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: Browse topics, consume and produce messages, and manage consumer groups and ACLs.

es.name: Kafka Studio
es.description: Plugin de consola Kafka para DBX: topics y particiones, producción/consumo de mensajes con filtros y decodificación, grupos de consumidores con lag y reset de offsets, ACL, consumo en streaming y exportación.

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Clúster Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: Conexión a Apache Kafka mediante PLAINTEXT, TLS y SASL (PLAIN/SCRAM); credenciales gestionadas por el host mediante secret binding.

display_name.label: Nombre de la conexión
display_name.description: Nombre que se muestra en la lista de conexiones.

bootstrap_servers.label: Servidores bootstrap
bootstrap_servers.description: Lista de brokers separada por comas o saltos de línea (host:puerto).

security_protocol.label: Protocolo de seguridad
security_protocol.description: Protocolo utilizado para conectarse a los brokers.

sasl_mechanism.label: Mecanismo SASL
sasl_mechanism.description: Mecanismo SASL usado para SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL.

sasl_username.label: Usuario SASL
sasl_username.description: Nombre de usuario para el mecanismo SASL; obligatorio para los mecanismos PLAIN y SCRAM (no se necesita para GSSAPI).

sasl_password.label: Contraseña SASL
sasl_password.description: Contraseña para el mecanismo SASL; obligatoria para los mecanismos PLAIN y SCRAM (no se necesita para GSSAPI); se guarda mediante secret binding del host, el plugin nunca la persiste.

oauth_token_source.label: Origen del token OAuth
oauth_token_source.description: Elija AWS MSK IAM o un token estático. OAUTHBEARER requiere SASL sobre TLS (SASL_SSL).

msk_region.label: Región de AWS de MSK
msk_region.description: Región de AWS del clúster de MSK usada para firmar el token de IAM (por ejemplo us-east-1); obligatoria cuando el origen del token OAuth es MSK IAM.

msk_access_key_id.label: ID de clave de acceso de AWS
msk_access_key_id.description: ID de clave de acceso usado para firmar el token de IAM de MSK; déjelo vacío para usar la cadena de credenciales predeterminada de AWS.

msk_secret_access_key.label: Clave de acceso secreta de AWS
msk_secret_access_key.description: Clave de acceso secreta usada para firmar el token de IAM de MSK (se proporciona junto con el ID de clave de acceso); se guarda mediante secret binding del host, el complemento nunca la persiste.

msk_session_token.label: Token de sesión de AWS
msk_session_token.description: Token de sesión temporal opcional (STS) para las credenciales de MSK IAM; déjelo vacío para claves de larga duración.

oauth_static_token.label: Token estático de OAuth
oauth_static_token.description: Token estático de OAUTHBEARER enviado tal cual durante la autenticación SASL; obligatorio cuando el origen del token OAuth es token estático; se guarda mediante secret binding del host, el complemento nunca lo persiste.

tls_ca_cert.label: Certificado CA (PEM)
tls_ca_cert.description: Certificado CA en formato PEM usado para verificar los certificados de los brokers; vacío usa las raíces del sistema.

tls_client_cert.label: Certificado de cliente (PEM)
tls_client_cert.description: Certificado de cliente en formato PEM para TLS mutuo (mTLS).

tls_client_key.label: Clave privada del cliente (PEM)
tls_client_key.description: Pegue la clave PEM completa, incluidas BEGIN/END, junto con el certificado de cliente para TLS mutuo. Deje ambos vacíos para TLS solo de servidor.

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: Omitir verificación TLS
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: Acepta los certificados de los brokers sin verificarlos (solo desarrollo).

client_id.label: ID de cliente
client_id.description: client.id opcional reportado a los brokers; por defecto dbx-plugin-kafka.

read_only.label: Modo de solo lectura
read_only.description: Rechaza todas las operaciones de escritura (producir mensajes, crear/modificar/eliminar topics, eliminar grupos y reset de offsets, escrituras ACL).

allow_delete.label: Permitir operaciones de borrado
allow_delete.description: Permite operaciones de borrado (topics/delete, groups/delete, acls/delete); sin efecto en modo de solo lectura.

connection_source.label: Origen de la conexión
connection_source.description: De dónde salen las direcciones de los brokers: lista bootstrap directa o descubrimiento vía ZooKeeper (zk_servers).

zk_servers.label: Servidores ZooKeeper
zk_servers.description: Conjunto ZooKeeper separado por comas (host:puerto[/chroot]); se usa para descubrir brokers cuando el origen es zookeeper.

kerberos_service_name.label: Nombre de servicio Kerberos
kerberos_service_name.description: Nombre de servicio Kafka usado para el ticket GSSAPI (primera parte del principal kafka/BROKER@REALM).

kerberos_realm.label: Realm de Kerberos
kerberos_realm.description: Realm de Kerberos; vacío lo deduce de kerberos_principal (usuario@REALM) o de krb5.conf.

kerberos_principal.label: Principal de Kerberos
kerberos_principal.description: Principal del cliente en forma usuario@REALM usado con el keytab; obligatorio para GSSAPI.

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Ruta del keytab de Kerberos
kerberos_keytab_path.description: Ruta del archivo keytab en esta máquina (solo la ruta, nunca el contenido); obligatorio para GSSAPI.

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: Ruta de krb5.conf
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: Ruta de krb5.conf; vacío usa $KRB5_CONFIG y luego /etc/krb5.conf.

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Backend de Schema Registry a utilizar: none (funciones de esquemas desactivadas), REST compatible con Confluent o AWS Glue Schema Registry.

sr_url.label: URL de Schema Registry
sr_url.description: URL base de un Schema Registry compatible con Confluent (incluido el de Redpanda); obligatoria cuando el schema registry es compatible con Confluent.

sr_username.label: Usuario de Schema Registry
sr_username.description: Usuario para basic auth del Schema Registry; déjelo vacío si no requiere autenticación.

sr_password.label: Contraseña de Schema Registry
sr_password.description: Contraseña para basic auth del Schema Registry; se guarda mediante secret binding del host, el plugin nunca la persiste.

glue_region.label: Región de AWS Glue
glue_region.description: Región de AWS del Glue Schema Registry (por ejemplo us-east-1); obligatoria cuando el schema registry es AWS Glue.

glue_registry_name.label: Nombre del registry de AWS Glue
glue_registry_name.description: Nombre del schema registry de AWS Glue usado como espacio de nombres de subjects para la gestión de esquemas de Glue; obligatorio cuando el schema registry es AWS Glue.

glue_auth_mode.label: Modo de autenticación de AWS Glue
glue_auth_mode.description: Origen de credenciales de AWS para Glue: cadena predeterminada (entorno/configuración compartida) o clave de acceso estática.

options.default: Cadena de credenciales predeterminada de AWS

glue_access_key_id.label: ID de clave de acceso de AWS
glue_access_key_id.description: ID de clave de acceso usado cuando el modo de autenticación de Glue es estático (obligatorio en ese caso); déjelo vacío para la cadena de credenciales predeterminada.

glue_secret_access_key.label: Clave de acceso secreta de AWS
glue_secret_access_key.description: Clave de acceso secreta de las credenciales estáticas de AWS (obligatoria cuando el modo de autenticación de Glue es estático); se guarda mediante secret binding del host, el complemento nunca la persiste.

glue_session_token.label: Token de sesión de AWS
glue_session_token.description: Token de sesión temporal opcional para las credenciales estáticas de AWS (STS); déjelo vacío para claves de larga duración.

properties_import.label: Importar: pegar propiedades del cliente
properties_import.description: Opcional: pegue un fragmento de propiedades del cliente Kafka (bootstrap.servers, security.protocol, sasl.*, ssl.*, schema.registry.url, basic.auth.*). Las claves reconocidas se fusionan en los campos anteriores al guardar o probar la conexión (los valores pegados tienen prioridad); las claves de ruta de keystore de Java (ssl.truststore.location y similares) no se admiten y se indican como ignoradas. El texto pegado se guarda mediante secret binding del host, nunca en texto plano.

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Banco de trabajo Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: Explore topics, consuma y produzca mensajes y gestione grupos de consumidores y ACL.

it.name: Kafka Studio
it.description: Plugin console Kafka per DBX: topic e partizioni, produzione/consumo di messaggi con filtri e decodifica, gruppi di consumatori con lag e reset degli offset, ACL, consumo in streaming ed esportazione.

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Cluster Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: Connessione ad Apache Kafka tramite PLAINTEXT, TLS e SASL (PLAIN/SCRAM); credenziali gestite dall'host tramite secret binding.

bootstrap_servers.label: Server bootstrap
bootstrap_servers.description: Elenco di broker separato da virgole o a capo (host:porta).

security_protocol.label: Protocollo di sicurezza
security_protocol.description: Protocollo usato per connettersi ai broker.

sasl_mechanism.label: Meccanismo SASL
sasl_mechanism.description: Meccanismo SASL usato per SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL.

sasl_username.label: Nome utente SASL
sasl_username.description: Nome utente per il meccanismo SASL; obbligatorio per i meccanismi PLAIN e SCRAM (non necessario per GSSAPI).

sasl_password.label: Password SASL
sasl_password.description: Password per il meccanismo SASL; obbligatoria per i meccanismi PLAIN e SCRAM (non necessaria per GSSAPI); salvata tramite secret binding dell'host, mai persistita dal plugin.

oauth_token_source.label: Origine del token OAuth
oauth_token_source.description: Scegli AWS MSK IAM o un token statico. OAUTHBEARER richiede SASL su TLS (SASL_SSL).

msk_region.label: Regione AWS di MSK
msk_region.description: Regione AWS del cluster MSK usata per firmare il token IAM (ad esempio us-east-1); obbligatoria quando l'origine del token OAuth è MSK IAM.

msk_access_key_id.label: ID chiave di accesso AWS
msk_access_key_id.description: ID della chiave di accesso usato per firmare il token IAM di MSK; lascia vuoto per usare la catena di credenziali predefinita AWS.

msk_secret_access_key.label: Chiave di accesso segreta AWS
msk_secret_access_key.description: Chiave di accesso segreta usata per firmare il token IAM di MSK (fornita insieme all'ID chiave di accesso); salvata tramite secret binding dell'host, il plugin non la persiste.

msk_session_token.label: Token di sessione AWS
msk_session_token.description: Token di sessione temporaneo facoltativo (STS) per le credenziali MSK IAM; lascia vuoto per chiavi di lunga durata.

oauth_static_token.label: Token statico OAuth
oauth_static_token.description: Token statico OAUTHBEARER inviato così com'è durante l'autenticazione SASL; obbligatorio quando l'origine del token OAuth è token statico; salvato tramite secret binding dell'host, il plugin non lo persiste.

tls_ca_cert.label: Certificato CA (PEM)
tls_ca_cert.description: Certificato CA in formato PEM usato per verificare i certificati dei broker; vuoto usa le radici di sistema.

tls_client_cert.label: Certificato client (PEM)
tls_client_cert.description: Certificato client in formato PEM per TLS reciproco (mTLS).

tls_client_key.label: Chiave privata del client (PEM)
tls_client_key.description: Incolla la chiave PEM completa, incluse BEGIN/END, con il certificato client per TLS reciproco. Lascia entrambi vuoti per TLS solo server.

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: Salta verifica TLS
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: Accetta i certificati dei broker senza verificarli (solo sviluppo).

client_id.label: ID client
client_id.description: client.id facoltativo riportato ai broker; predefinito dbx-plugin-kafka.

read_only.label: Modalità sola lettura
read_only.description: Rifiuta tutte le operazioni di scrittura (produzione messaggi, creazione/modifica/eliminazione topic, eliminazione gruppi e reset offset, scritture ACL).

allow_delete.label: Consenti operazioni di eliminazione
allow_delete.description: Consente le operazioni di eliminazione (topics/delete, groups/delete, acls/delete); senza effetto in modalità sola lettura.

connection_source.label: Origine della connessione
connection_source.description: Da dove arrivano gli indirizzi dei broker: lista bootstrap diretta oppure scoperta via ZooKeeper (zk_servers).

zk_servers.label: Server ZooKeeper
zk_servers.description: Ensemble ZooKeeper separato da virgole (host:porta[/chroot]); usato per scoprire i broker quando l'origine è zookeeper.

kerberos_service_name.label: Nome servizio Kerberos
kerberos_service_name.description: Nome servizio Kafka usato per il ticket GSSAPI (prima parte del principal kafka/BROKER@REALM).

kerberos_realm.label: Realm Kerberos
kerberos_realm.description: Realm Kerberos; vuoto lo deduce da kerberos_principal (utente@REALM) o da krb5.conf.

kerberos_principal.label: Principal Kerberos
kerberos_principal.description: Principal del client in forma utente@REALM usato con il keytab; obbligatorio per GSSAPI.

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Percorso keytab Kerberos
kerberos_keytab_path.description: Percorso del file keytab su questa macchina (solo il percorso, mai il contenuto); obbligatorio per GSSAPI.

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: Percorso krb5.conf
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: Percorso di krb5.conf; vuoto usa $KRB5_CONFIG e poi /etc/krb5.conf.

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Quale backend Schema Registry usare: none (funzioni schema disattivate), REST compatibile Confluent oppure AWS Glue Schema Registry.

sr_url.label: URL Schema Registry
sr_url.description: URL base di uno Schema Registry compatibile Confluent (incluso quello integrato di Redpanda); obbligatorio quando lo schema registry è compatibile Confluent.

sr_username.label: Nome utente Schema Registry
sr_username.description: Nome utente per il basic auth dello Schema Registry; lasciare vuoto se non richiede autenticazione.

sr_password.label: Password Schema Registry
sr_password.description: Password per il basic auth dello Schema Registry; salvata tramite secret binding dell'host, mai persistita dal plugin.

glue_region.label: Regione AWS Glue
glue_region.description: Regione AWS del Glue Schema Registry (ad esempio us-east-1); obbligatoria quando lo schema registry è AWS Glue.

glue_registry_name.label: Nome registry AWS Glue
glue_registry_name.description: Nome dello schema registry AWS Glue usato come namespace dei subject per la gestione degli schemi Glue; obbligatorio quando lo schema registry è AWS Glue.

glue_auth_mode.label: Modalità di autenticazione AWS Glue
glue_auth_mode.description: Origine delle credenziali AWS per Glue: catena predefinita (ambiente/configurazione condivisa) o chiave di accesso statica.

glue_access_key_id.label: ID chiave di accesso AWS
glue_access_key_id.description: ID della chiave di accesso usato quando la modalità di autenticazione Glue è statica (obbligatorio in quel caso); lascia vuoto per la catena di credenziali predefinita.

glue_secret_access_key.label: Chiave di accesso segreta AWS
glue_secret_access_key.description: Chiave di accesso segreta delle credenziali AWS statiche (obbligatoria quando la modalità di autenticazione Glue è statica); salvata tramite secret binding dell'host, il plugin non la persiste.

glue_session_token.label: Token di sessione AWS
glue_session_token.description: Token di sessione temporaneo facoltativo per le credenziali AWS statiche (STS); lascia vuoto per chiavi di lunga durata.

properties_import.label: Importa: incolla le proprietà del client
properties_import.description: Facoltativo: incolla uno snippet di proprietà del client Kafka (bootstrap.servers, security.protocol, sasl.*, ssl.*, schema.registry.url, basic.auth.*). Le chiavi riconosciute vengono unite ai campi precedenti al salvataggio o al test della connessione (i valori incollati hanno priorità); le chiavi con percorso keystore Java (ssl.truststore.location e simili) non sono supportate e vengono indicate come ignorate. Il testo incollato viene salvato tramite secret binding dell'host, mai in chiaro.

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Banco di lavoro Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: Sfoglia i topic, consuma e produci messaggi e gestisci gruppi di consumatori e ACL.

ja.name: Kafka Studio
ja.description: DBX 用 Kafka コンソールプラグイン: トピックとパーティション、フィルタリング/デコード付きメッセージ送受信、コンシューマーグループ（ラグと offset リセット）、ACL、ストリーミング消費とエクスポート。

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Kafka クラスター
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: PLAINTEXT・TLS・SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）で Apache Kafka に接続。認証情報はホストの secret binding で管理され、プラグインは永続化しません。

display_name.label: 接続名
display_name.description: 接続一覧に表示される名前。

bootstrap_servers.label: Bootstrap サーバー
bootstrap_servers.description: カンマまたは改行区切りのブローカーリスト（host:port）。

security_protocol.label: セキュリティプロトコル
security_protocol.description: ブローカーとの接続に使用するプロトコル。

sasl_mechanism.label: SASL メカニズム
sasl_mechanism.description: SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL で使用する SASL メカニズム。

options.OAUTHBEARER: OAUTHBEARER（MSK IAM / 静的トークン）

sasl_username.label: SASL ユーザー名
sasl_username.description: SASL 認証に使用するユーザー名。PLAIN/SCRAM メカニズムでは必須（GSSAPI では不要）。

sasl_password.label: SASL パスワード
sasl_password.description: SASL 認証に使用するパスワード。PLAIN/SCRAM メカニズムでは必須（GSSAPI では不要）。ホストの secret binding で保存され、プラグインは永続化しません。

oauth_token_source.label: OAuth トークンソース
oauth_token_source.description: AWS MSK IAM または静的トークンを選択してください。OAUTHBEARER には SASL over TLS（SASL_SSL）が必要です。

options.msk_iam: AWS MSK IAM（署名トークン）

msk_region.label: MSK AWS リージョン
msk_region.description: MSK クラスターの AWS リージョン（例: us-east-1）。IAM トークンの署名に使用します。OAuth トークンソースが MSK IAM の場合は必須。

msk_access_key_id.label: AWS アクセスキー ID
msk_access_key_id.description: MSK IAM トークンの署名に使うアクセスキー ID。空にすると AWS デフォルト認証情報チェーンを使用します。

msk_secret_access_key.label: AWS シークレットアクセスキー
msk_secret_access_key.description: MSK IAM トークンの署名に使うシークレットアクセスキー（アクセスキー ID とセットで提供）。ホストの secret binding で保存され、プラグインは永続化しません。

msk_session_token.label: AWS セッショントークン
msk_session_token.description: MSK IAM 認証情報用の任意の一時セッショントークン（STS）。長期キーの場合は空にします。

oauth_static_token.label: OAuth 静的トークン
oauth_static_token.description: SASL 認証でそのまま送信する OAUTHBEARER 静的トークン。OAuth トークンソースが静的トークンの場合は必須。ホストの secret binding で保存され、プラグインは永続化しません。

tls_ca_cert.label: CA 証明書（PEM）
tls_ca_cert.description: ブローカー証明書の検証に使う PEM 形式の CA 証明書。空の場合はシステムのルート証明書を使用します。

tls_client_cert.label: クライアント証明書（PEM）
tls_client_cert.description: 相互 TLS（mTLS）に使う PEM 形式のクライアント証明書。

tls_client_key.label: クライアント秘密鍵（PEM）
tls_client_key.description: BEGIN/END 行を含む完全な PEM 秘密鍵を貼り付けてください。相互 TLS ではクライアント証明書とセットで指定します。サーバー認証のみの場合は両方空欄にします。

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: TLS 検証をスキップ
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: ブローカー証明書を検証せずに受け入れます（開発環境向け）。

client_id.label: クライアント ID
client_id.description: ブローカーに報告される任意の client.id。既定は dbx-plugin-kafka。

read_only.label: 読み取り専用
read_only.description: すべての書き込み操作を拒否します（メッセージ送信、トピックの作成/変更/削除、コンシューマーグループ削除と offset リセット、ACL 書き込み）。

allow_delete.label: 削除系操作を許可
allow_delete.description: 削除系操作（topics/delete、groups/delete、acls/delete）を許可します。読み取り専用では無効です。

connection_source.label: 接続ソース
connection_source.description: ブローカーアドレスの取得元：bootstrap リストへ直接、または ZooKeeper（zk_servers）から発見。

zk_servers.label: ZooKeeper サーバー
zk_servers.description: カンマ区切りの ZooKeeper アンサンブル（host:port[/chroot]）。接続ソースが zookeeper のときにブローカー発見に使用します。

kerberos_service_name.label: Kerberos サービス名
kerberos_service_name.description: GSSAPI チケットに使う Kafka サービス名（ブローカー principal kafka/BROKER@REALM の先頭部分）。

kerberos_realm.label: Kerberos レルム
kerberos_realm.description: Kerberos レルム。空の場合は kerberos_principal（user@REALM）または krb5.conf から推測します。

kerberos_principal.label: Kerberos プリンシパル
kerberos_principal.description: keytab と組み合わせて使うクライアント principal（user@REALM 形式）。GSSAPI では必須。

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Kerberos keytab パス
kerberos_keytab_path.description: このマシン上の keytab ファイルパス（パスのみで内容は不要）。GSSAPI では必須です。

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: krb5.conf パス
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: krb5.conf のパス。空の場合は $KRB5_CONFIG、次に /etc/krb5.conf にフォールバックします。

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: 使用する Schema Registry バックエンド: none（スキーマ機能を無効化）、Confluent 互換 REST、または AWS Glue Schema Registry。

sr_url.label: Schema Registry URL
sr_url.description: Confluent 互換 Schema Registry のベース URL（Redpanda 内蔵レジストリを含む）。schema registry が Confluent 互換の場合は必須。

sr_username.label: Schema Registry ユーザー名
sr_username.description: Schema Registry basic auth のユーザー名。認証不要のレジストリでは空にします。

sr_password.label: Schema Registry パスワード
sr_password.description: Schema Registry basic auth のパスワード。ホストの secret binding で保存され、プラグインは永続化しません。

glue_region.label: AWS Glue リージョン
glue_region.description: Glue Schema Registry の AWS リージョン（例: us-east-1）。schema registry が AWS Glue の場合は必須。

glue_registry_name.label: AWS Glue レジストリ名
glue_registry_name.description: AWS Glue スキーマレジストリの名前。Glue スキーマ管理のサブジェクト名前空間として使用します。schema registry が AWS Glue の場合は必須。

glue_auth_mode.label: AWS Glue 認証モード
glue_auth_mode.description: Glue が使用する AWS 認証情報の取得元：デフォルトチェーン（環境変数/共有設定）または静的アクセスキー。

options.default: AWS デフォルト認証情報チェーン

glue_access_key_id.label: AWS アクセスキー ID
glue_access_key_id.description: Glue 認証モードが静的アクセスキーの場合に使用するアクセスキー ID（その場合は必須）。デフォルトチェーンを使う場合は空にします。

glue_secret_access_key.label: AWS シークレットアクセスキー
glue_secret_access_key.description: 静的 AWS 認証情報のシークレットアクセスキー（Glue 認証モードが静的アクセスキーの場合は必須）。ホストの secret binding で保存され、プラグインは永続化しません。

glue_session_token.label: AWS セッショントークン
glue_session_token.description: 静的 AWS 認証情報用の任意の一時セッショントークン（STS）。長期キーの場合は空にします。

properties_import.label: インポート：クライアント properties を貼り付け
properties_import.description: 任意：Kafka クライアントの properties 断片（bootstrap.servers、security.protocol、sasl.*、ssl.*、schema.registry.url、basic.auth.*）を貼り付けます。接続の保存・テスト時に認識されたキーは上の構造化フィールドへ統合されます（貼り付け値が優先）。Java キーストアのパス系キー（ssl.truststore.location など）は非対応で「無視」として報告されます。貼り付けテキストはホストの secret binding で保存され、平文で永続化されることはありません。

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Kafka ワークベンチ
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: トピックの閲覧、メッセージの送受信、コンシューマーグループと ACL の管理。

pt-BR.name: Kafka Studio
pt-BR.description: Plugin de console Kafka para o DBX: tópicos e partições, produção/consumo de mensagens com filtros e decodificação, grupos de consumidores com lag e redefinição de offsets, ACLs, consumo em streaming e exportação.

io.dbx.kafka.connection.label: Cluster Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.connection.description: Conexão ao Apache Kafka via PLAINTEXT, TLS e SASL (PLAIN/SCRAM); credenciais gerenciadas pelo host via secret binding.

display_name.label: Nome da conexão
display_name.description: Nome exibido na lista de conexões.

bootstrap_servers.label: Servidores bootstrap
bootstrap_servers.description: Lista de brokers separada por vírgulas ou quebras de linha (host:porta).

security_protocol.label: Protocolo de segurança
security_protocol.description: Protocolo usado para conectar aos brokers.

sasl_mechanism.label: Mecanismo SASL
sasl_mechanism.description: Mecanismo SASL usado para SASL_PLAINTEXT / SASL_SSL.

sasl_username.label: Usuário SASL
sasl_username.description: Nome de usuário para o mecanismo SASL; obrigatório para os mecanismos PLAIN e SCRAM (não é necessário para GSSAPI).

sasl_password.label: Senha SASL
sasl_password.description: Senha para o mecanismo SASL; obrigatória para os mecanismos PLAIN e SCRAM (não é necessária para GSSAPI); armazenada via secret binding do host, nunca persistida pelo plugin.

oauth_token_source.label: Origem do token OAuth
oauth_token_source.description: Escolha AWS MSK IAM ou um token estático. OAUTHBEARER exige SASL sobre TLS (SASL_SSL).

msk_region.label: Região da AWS do MSK
msk_region.description: Região da AWS do cluster MSK usada para assinar o token do IAM (por exemplo us-east-1); obrigatória quando a origem do token OAuth for MSK IAM.

msk_access_key_id.label: ID da chave de acesso da AWS
msk_access_key_id.description: ID da chave de acesso usado para assinar o token do IAM do MSK; deixe vazio para usar a cadeia de credenciais padrão da AWS.

msk_secret_access_key.label: Chave de acesso secreta da AWS
msk_secret_access_key.description: Chave de acesso secreta usada para assinar o token do IAM do MSK (fornecida junto com o ID da chave de acesso); armazenada via secret binding do host, o plugin nunca a persiste.

msk_session_token.label: Token de sessão da AWS
msk_session_token.description: Token de sessão temporário opcional (STS) para as credenciais do MSK IAM; deixe vazio para chaves de longa duração.

oauth_static_token.label: Token estático do OAuth
oauth_static_token.description: Token estático OAUTHBEARER enviado como está durante a autenticação SASL; obrigatório quando a origem do token OAuth for token estático; armazenado via secret binding do host, o plugin nunca o persiste.

tls_ca_cert.label: Certificado CA (PEM)
tls_ca_cert.description: Certificado CA em formato PEM usado para verificar os certificados dos brokers; vazio usa as raízes do sistema.

tls_client_cert.label: Certificado do cliente (PEM)
tls_client_cert.description: Certificado do cliente em formato PEM para TLS mútuo (mTLS).

tls_client_key.label: Chave privada do cliente (PEM)
tls_client_key.description: Cole a chave PEM completa, incluindo BEGIN/END, com o certificado de cliente para TLS mútuo. Deixe ambos vazios para TLS apenas do servidor.

tls_insecure_skip_verify.label: Ignorar verificação TLS
tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: Aceita os certificados dos brokers sem verificar (apenas desenvolvimento).

client_id.label: ID do cliente
client_id.description: client.id opcional informado aos brokers; padrão dbx-plugin-kafka.

read_only.label: Modo somente leitura
read_only.description: Rejeita todas as operações de escrita (produzir mensagens, criar/alterar/excluir topics, excluir grupos e redefinir offsets, escritas de ACL).

allow_delete.label: Permitir operações de exclusão
allow_delete.description: Permite operações de exclusão (topics/delete, groups/delete, acls/delete); sem efeito no modo somente leitura.

connection_source.label: Origem da conexão
connection_source.description: De onde vêm os endereços dos brokers: lista bootstrap direta ou descoberta via ZooKeeper (zk_servers).

zk_servers.label: Servidores ZooKeeper
zk_servers.description: Ensemble ZooKeeper separado por vírgulas (host:porta[/chroot]); usado para descobrir brokers quando a origem é zookeeper.

kerberos_service_name.label: Nome de serviço Kerberos
kerberos_service_name.description: Nome de serviço Kafka usado no ticket GSSAPI (primeira parte do principal kafka/BROKER@REALM).

kerberos_realm.label: Realm do Kerberos
kerberos_realm.description: Realm do Kerberos; vazio deriva de kerberos_principal (usuario@REALM) ou do krb5.conf.

kerberos_principal.label: Principal do Kerberos
kerberos_principal.description: Principal do cliente no formato usuario@REALM usado com o keytab; obrigatório para GSSAPI.

kerberos_keytab_path.label: Caminho do keytab Kerberos
kerberos_keytab_path.description: Caminho do arquivo keytab nesta máquina (apenas o caminho, nunca o conteúdo); obrigatório para GSSAPI.

kerberos_krb5_conf_path.label: Caminho do krb5.conf
kerberos_krb5_conf_path.description: Caminho do krb5.conf; vazio usa $KRB5_CONFIG e depois /etc/krb5.conf.

schema_registry.label: Schema Registry
schema_registry.description: Qual backend de Schema Registry usar: none (recursos de esquema desativados), REST compatível com Confluent ou AWS Glue Schema Registry.

sr_url.label: URL do Schema Registry
sr_url.description: URL base de um Schema Registry compatível com Confluent (incluindo o embutido do Redpanda); obrigatória quando o schema registry for compatível com Confluent.

sr_username.label: Usuário do Schema Registry
sr_username.description: Usuário do basic auth do Schema Registry; deixe vazio se o registry não exige autenticação.

sr_password.label: Senha do Schema Registry
sr_password.description: Senha do basic auth do Schema Registry; armazenada via secret binding do host, nunca persistida pelo plugin.

glue_region.label: Região da AWS Glue
glue_region.description: Região da AWS do Glue Schema Registry (por exemplo us-east-1); obrigatória quando o schema registry for AWS Glue.

glue_registry_name.label: Nome do registry da AWS Glue
glue_registry_name.description: Nome do schema registry da AWS Glue usado como namespace de subjects para o gerenciamento de esquemas do Glue; obrigatório quando o schema registry for AWS Glue.

glue_auth_mode.label: Modo de autenticação da AWS Glue
glue_auth_mode.description: Origem das credenciais da AWS para o Glue: cadeia padrão (ambiente/configuração compartilhada) ou chave de acesso estática.

options.default: Cadeia de credenciais padrão da AWS

glue_access_key_id.label: ID da chave de acesso da AWS
glue_access_key_id.description: ID da chave de acesso usado quando o modo de autenticação do Glue é estático (obrigatório nesse caso); deixe vazio para a cadeia de credenciais padrão.

glue_secret_access_key.label: Chave de acesso secreta da AWS
glue_secret_access_key.description: Chave de acesso secreta das credenciais estáticas da AWS (obrigatória quando o modo de autenticação do Glue é estático); armazenada via secret binding do host, o plugin nunca a persiste.

glue_session_token.label: Token de sessão da AWS
glue_session_token.description: Token de sessão temporário opcional para as credenciais estáticas da AWS (STS); deixe vazio para chaves de longa duração.

properties_import.label: Importar: colar propriedades do cliente
properties_import.description: Opcional: cole um trecho de propriedades do cliente Kafka (bootstrap.servers, security.protocol, sasl.*, ssl.*, schema.registry.url, basic.auth.*). As chaves reconhecidas são mescladas nos campos acima ao salvar ou testar a conexão (valores colados têm prioridade); chaves de caminho de keystore Java (ssl.truststore.location e similares) não são suportadas e são reportadas como ignoradas. O texto colado é armazenado via secret binding do host, nunca em texto simples.

io.dbx.kafka.workbench.label: Bancada de trabalho Kafka
io.dbx.kafka.workbench.description: Navegue por tópicos, consuma e produza mensagens e gerencie grupos de consumidores e ACLs.
